{{Top|leg}}
'''Tyrol''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Tyrol commented on the entry for the [[Model-3287]] [[luma flare]], advising that it was a non-lethal way to take out a group of enemies if employed properly.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
